description: Every pinned version in this repo stays current, one PR a week. Nothing merges itself and nobody is tagged. tests/compat is tracked on purpose: the compatibility matrix should follow the packages' latest releases. Left by hand: the CPython versions and archive hashes in tools/build_launcher.py and the embedded runtimes CI downloads, which are the ABI coil targets.

packageRules.description: Workflow Python versions are chosen, not drifting: 3.12 is coil-rt's cp312 target (3.12.10 is the ABI the generated layouts and export lists are checked against), and the 3.9/3.13 matrix is the supported range. Change them by hand with the code.
One grouped PR for everything that isn't a major version.
Majors come one per PR, since they may need code changes.

customManagers.description: Tools CI downloads from GitHub releases: a `tag=` line, then the URL, then its sha256.
